texts.en:
Synthesization of the entire [root.GetSpeciesAdj] species has also meant a drastic shift in our housing practices; with minds resting easy in massive server farms, synthetic bodies can be stored in shelves. While this represents a cost-effective solution, some advocacy groups are raising some very real concerns.

The previously lucrative real-estate market could collapse entirely, leaving a considerable dent in our economy. Potentially more damaging, at least from a psychological perspective, is that people will no longer have a physical place to call home.

summary.text:
# 家庭服务器建筑 / Home Server Architecture

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “合成冲击”事件链中段：隐藏事件 synth.600 在 505–525 之一的选项后180+随机90天，从 on_synthshock_chain_identity_events_list（610、620、630，权重各5）抽取一个。
  Middle of the "Synth Shock" chain: hidden synth.600 fires 180 days (+ random 90) after an option of 505-525 and draws one of 610, 620, 630 (weight 5 each) from on_synthshock_chain_identity_events_list.
- 无额外触发条件。
  No extra trigger.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「家庭服务器架构」：synth_home_centralized / _distributed；巨型企业 synth_digital_homes。
  "Home Server Architecture": synth_home_centralized / _distributed; megacorps synth_digital_homes.
- 选项后由 synth.1000 衔接。
  Followed by synth.1000.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口（无后续或只通向共享结局）；选项互斥，只能选一个。
  A single window (no follow-up, or only into the shared ending); options are exclusive, only one is chosen.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项集合随帝国的伦理、权威、政体特质而变，见条件。
  The available options vary with ethics, authority and civics, see the conditions.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_2.txt:1996-2070`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`
- 已核对：来源池与权重、触发条件、选项分支与目标事件。
  Checked: source pool and weights, trigger conditions, option branches and target events.
- 未逐行核对选项的数值收益，只记录其性质（修正名、资源、标志）。
  Option numbers were not checked line by line; only their nature (modifier names, resources, flags) is recorded.
